abilities.name: Blessing of Light
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.desc: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.desc: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 96 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 216 damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Favor
abilities.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.desc: Causes 475 to 529 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

abilities.name: Flash of Light
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 291 to 325.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Light
abilities.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Light, increasing the effects of Holy Light spells used on the target by up to 400 and the effect Flash of Light spells used on the target by up to 115. Lasts 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 40 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
abilities.desc: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 474 to 522 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 1,495 to 1,665.

abilities.name: Holy Shock
abilities.desc: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 334 to 362 Holy damage to an enemy, or 307 to 333 healing to an ally.

abilities.name: Holy Wrath
abilities.desc: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 490 to 576 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds and stunning them for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

abilities.name: Light's Vigil
abilities.desc: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 380 to 410 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 684 to 724. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.desc: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

abilities.name: Redemption
abilities.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Seal of Light
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 94. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 61. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Seal of Righteousness
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 22 to 75 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 170 to 186 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Seal of Wisdom
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 90 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 59 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Sense Undead
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.desc: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

abilities.name: Voice of Truth
abilities.desc: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Blessing of Freedom
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Blessing of Protection
abilities.desc: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 55 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Concentration Aura
abilities.desc: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Devotion Aura
abilities.desc: Gives 735 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.desc: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.

abilities.name: Divine Protection
abilities.desc: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.desc: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Aura
abilities.desc: Gives 60 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Aura
abilities.desc: Gives 60 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
abilities.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.desc: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Holy Shield
abilities.desc: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat.

abilities.name: Mass Salvation
abilities.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target a reduction to all threat generated by 30% for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Revoke
abilities.desc: Remove target party or raid member's Salvation or Mass Salvation.

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.desc: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Salvation
abilities.desc: Reduces all threat generated by target party member by 30% for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Seal of Fury
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 153 to 167 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Seal of Justice
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
abilities.desc: Gives 60 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Swift Judgement
abilities.desc: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

abilities.name: Templar's Bulwark
abilities.desc: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

abilities.name: Blessing of Might
abilities.desc: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Might
abilities.desc: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 133 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.desc: An instant strike that causes 50% weapon damage plus an additional 40 to 53 as Holy damage.

abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.desc: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.

abilities.name: Repentance
abilities.desc: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

abilities.name: Retribution Aura
abilities.desc: Causes 20 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Seal of Command
abilities.desc:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 169 to 187 Holy damage, 339 to 373 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

abilities.name: Seal of the Crusader
abilities.desc:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 325 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 161. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
